science_vegetable: Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea
narrative_prose: Kaio's boots met the vibrating deck plates of the reactor bay, the air tasting of copper and ozone. A sharp, localized Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear ripped across the ferrofluid sea below, its jagged waves fighting to CONSUME the fragile containment fields. She moved quickly to CONCEAL the diagnostic tablet beneath her jacket, shielding it from the violent magnetic flare-ups, and scrambled toward the primary control node to DEFEND the delicate calibration from cascading failure. Ryn waited near the bulkhead, their face illuminated by the flickering warning lumens. Without missing a beat, Kaio shoved the data-drive directly into Ryn's outstretched hand, anchoring the transfer in the chaotic rhythm of the storm.
